answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own gale record, and its own share of the knoll quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The willow ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 4585 identities would post 2610 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
